source_branch_controls.scope: Brute-force structural implementation of repaired algorithm; no asymptotic implementation validation.

literal_v1_volume_counterexample.mechanism: Q_30 with t leaves at each unit vector and s leaves at 0. Give cube antipode omega=n and all other vertices omega=0. Its wide ladder is all 30 core classes. Pendant attachments preserve medianity. Every cut is natural-log-unbalanced, yet two copies of all slices contain more than n vertices. This refutes the literal volume bound, not correctness or the theorem after threshold repair.

limitations: No implementation of linear-time Theta/halfspace preprocessing.
No runtime experiment certifies an asymptotic theorem.
Classical median structural theorems are relied on, not formally proved.
